description:
I sometimes look back and think.   

Lee Shin.  

What if I had made a different choice on the day I first met him?  

"Hello?"  

What if, instead of greeting him like that, I had pretended not to know him? If I had done that, wouldn't Lee Seung-woo still be alive?   

No, to be more precise, could I have avoided being murdered by him? Even while harboring such doubts, I couldn't bring myself to ask him. It wasn't because I lacked courage. 

"Today is your ovulation day, noona. The kind of day you like it rough."

I liked having sex with him. I loved the coercive, explosive sex so much that I tore down the walls of doubt with my own hands. Believing that there was no way he could have murdered my ex-boyfriend, I willingly laid beneath him.   
Lee Shin. Without knowing whether he—with a name meaning 'god'—was truly a god or a devil.
